claims.evidence: No stress test, load test, or material spec is visible in a photo; durability cannot be judged from a single angled image.
Report notes visible wear and dirt on the frame, so 'perfect condition' is not supported by the image.

risks.risk: Rear wheel, gears, chain, and drivetrain condition unknown
risks.proof: Clear side-on photo of the full drivetrain (rear derailleur, chain, cassette) and a close-up of the rear wheel

risks.risk: Frame damage, dents, rust, or cracks not visible from this angle
risks.proof: Multiple photos from both sides, top, and underside of the frame in good light
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible hidden structural damage

risks.risk: Tire tread wear and tube/puncture condition
risks.proof: Close-up photo of both tires showing tread and a photo of inflated tubes

risks.risk: Functional brakes and gear shifting not demonstrated
risks.proof: Short video clip of the seller braking and shifting through all gears

risks.risk: Seat, pedals, and cables condition/completeness not detailed
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seat, pedals, and all cable housings
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing/worn components needing replacement

risks.proof: Photo of any serial number/manufacture date sticker plus seller's purchase receipt or service record
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age, treated as older/high-use unit

proof_requests: Full side-view photos of both sides of the bicycle in good lighting
Close-up of both tires and tubes
Video of braking and full gear-shift cycle
Photo of seat, pedals, and cable housings
Any serial number, purchase receipt, or service history
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a generic bicycle with visible wear, so it can be priced at worst case (as a used, unverified-condition bike) while flagging the 'perfect condition' claim as contradicted and durability as unverifiable.
